prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I've spent weeks conducting a survey targeting speakers of different varieties of English, and the last two calls I had to make today were to a physician and a bartender. I had a great conversation with the bartender, who was very helpful, but I had so much trouble understanding what the physician was saying that I just gave up after about two minutes. Who has poor English skills?
A. The physician
B. Undetermined
C. The bartender
